meta.name: ALTAR’ — Тихая сила артефакта
meta.description: Source-derived design DNA for ALTAR’ jewelry storefront; distinguishes observed Stitch tokens from visual synthesis based on Miro and the live site.
source_references: Miro packaging and visual inspiration: https://miro.com/app/board/uXjVHkiIOhA=/
Existing DESIGN.md in Stitch project: Molten Relic Brutalism

color.palette_type: monochromatic with warm earth and restrained red accent

primary.role: charcoal canvas sampled from existing Stitch system

secondary.role: warm earth surface from Stitch tokens

accent.role: restrained crimson marker and primary action from Stitch tokens

neutral.usage: Layered dark canvas, cards, readable warm-light text and highlights; exact stops are from Stitch.

semantic.success: #A6B6A5 inferred muted green; use only for feedback

color.contrast_strategy: High contrast for product facts and controls; muted tonal variation for imagery-led editorial surfaces. Verify WCAG contrast before implementation.

typography.font_style_notes: Mechanical monospaced titles and labels paired with neutral, readable sans-serif body copy; source fonts and sizes come from Stitch.

spacing.content_density: spacious editorial with compact factual clusters
spacing.section_rhythm: Large pauses between story chapters; denser product details and purchase controls.

layout.max_content_width: 1440px inferred from desktop frame; adjust to screen
layout.breakpoints: mobile-first; exact breakpoints to validate in Stitch
layout.alignment_tendency: asymmetric editorial composition anchored by a consistent product grid

shape.border_usage: Occasional fine silver/charcoal hairlines; no enclosing border on every block

elevation.shadow_style: none or barely perceptible; source photography supplies depth

levels.high: reserved overlay with solid dark scrim

elevation.depth_cues: Tonal fields, crop, material, and light; no glass or red glow.

iconography.style: Minimal thin-line utility icons; preserve original ALTAR’ eye mark where available
iconography.preferred_set: Existing brand artwork or simple inline SVG; no emoji

motion.entrance_pattern: Short opacity/position reveal for image and editorial sections, only when it clarifies hierarchy
motion.philosophy: Minimal, tactile, and secondary to the photograph; respect reduced motion.

components.button_style: Angular rectangular actions; one high-contrast primary action at a time
components.input_style: Visible labels and clear focus state, dark field with legible text
components.card_style: Image-led product tiles with minimal framing; avoid generic boxed cards
components.navigation_pattern: Compact menu with discoverable cart; clear catalog and custom-order routes
components.modal_style: Solid dark scrim and sharp panel only when needed
components.list_style: Clean editorial product grid with consistent image ratios
components.component_notes: Prioritize real artifact photography and plain product facts; do not use fictional badges, stock counts, or material claims.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A small personal object displayed like a contemporary gallery artifact, open to the wearer's meaning
aesthetic.era_influence: Contemporary independent jewelry editorial; no single historical period asserted

visual_language.whitespace_usage: spacious around images and brand story; practical density for shopping facts
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Asymmetric image-led moments balanced by legible product information
visual_language.focal_strategy: one real piece or detail at a time
visual_language.contrast_level: high for type and action; moderate within dark image-led areas
visual_language.texture_usage: Use real surfaces, metal, stone, skin, paper and fabric from source photos; no decorative fake grain by default

composition.flow_direction: editorial vertical narrative into product browsing
composition.grouping_strategy: image and its product facts form one clear unit
composition.negative_space_role: gives each object room without hiding price or action

imagery.photo_treatment: Use original ALTAR’ imagery from Stitch/Miro; retain natural color and honest texture, crop intentionally, avoid generated substitute products
imagery.graphic_elements: Original ALTAR’ mark, restrained item codes and editorial rules
imagery.image_shape: sharp-cornered rectangular and occasional full-bleed crops

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: subtle image crop/scale and underline; no magnetic gimmicks
interaction_feel.loading_style: stable dark placeholder with image ratio preserved

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: Russian, personal, poetic but grounded in real product details
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: plain explanation and next action, no invented lore

overview.fallback_strategy: static photography and CSS only; disable entrance effects for reduced motion or constrained devices

background_effects.description: Use solid tonal surfaces; avoid generated atmospheric backgrounds that compete with product imagery.

particle_systems.description: No particle system is evidenced in the sources.

3d_elements.description: No 3D interface effect is evidenced; use actual product photography.

shader_effects.description: No shader effects in reference material.

scroll_triggered_animations.trigger_points: when an image/story section enters view
scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: play once; skip under reduced motion

scroll_morphing.description: No morphing evidenced; keep page geometry stable.

text_effects.description: Typography remains readable and static; no typewriter or glitch animation.

cursor_effects.description: Use the native cursor for accessibility.

image_effects.description: Preserve each image's ratio; allow a restrained hover crop/scale only where it signals interactivity.

canvas_drawings.description: No canvas drawing is evidenced in reference material.

svg_animations.description: Keep brand mark static unless an original animation is supplied.

visual_effects.composite_notes: Miro mood references include surreal, intimate photographs, but ALTAR’ explicitly avoids literal witch/goddess/occult representation. Use the owned jewelry and workshop photos in Stitch/Miro as the primary imagery; do not infer product identity from moodboard images. The packaging board's unboxing 'discovery' idea is a material/experience reference, not a requirement to place packaging props on every page.
